name: io.github.quirna/mcp
title: Quirna
description: Ask a human before your agent acts: approval requests decided on a phone.

environmentVariables.name: QUIRNA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Key of a System registered in the Quirna Console (Users → Systems).

environmentVariables.name: QUIRNA_REQUESTER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Who the Console shows as having asked. Defaults to "mcp".

environmentVariables.name: QUIRNA_REQUESTER_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Display name for the requester. Defaults to "AI agent".

environmentVariables.name: QUIRNA_ENVIRONMENT
environmentVariables.description: Environment used when a tool call names none. Empty means the org default.

environmentVariables.name: QUIRNA_WAIT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long a tool call waits for a decision before returning pending. Defaults to 90000.

environmentVariables.name: QUIRNA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Quirna API URL. Leave unset.
